element_semantics: Heap pointer (cast to/from uint32) to an FDOTHER.DAT SFX sample-bank entry buffer returned by fd2_load_dat_resource; 0 means not loaded. Accessed as a single 32-bit value via MOV dword ptr (not an array element).
